testimonials.subtitle: Real aspirants who cleared different stages of UPSC and UKPSC through personal mentorship and one-on-one guidance.

items.name: Priya Rawat
items.text: The personal mentorship made all the difference. My answer-writing was reviewed copy by copy and the one-on-one guidance was tailored to my weak areas — exactly what I needed to clear Assistant Commandant in 2025.

items.name: Rahul Hondadakeri
items.text: What helped me most was the direct teaching and doubt-solving sessions. Every time I got stuck, I got a clear explanation with the exam angle. That guidance on how to actually approach preparation carried me through KAS 2024.

items.name: Gaurav
items.text: The mentorship on Uttarakhand GK and the way concepts were taught with a PYQ focus completely changed my strategy. Being guided stage by stage, with my mistakes corrected early, made cracking RO/ARO possible.

items.name: Neha Bhatt
items.text: The personalised guidance on integrating current affairs with the syllabus was invaluable. The teaching style breaks down complex topics into things you actually remember in the exam hall — it took me through UPSC Mains 2022 and the Interview stage in 2024.

items.name: Vikas Kandpal
items.text: From Mains answer writing to interview preparation, the one-on-one mentorship carried me through every stage. The mock-interview feedback and honest, personal guidance ahead of my 2024 interview was something no book or generic course could provide.
